# SplitBooks

> SplitBooks is a shared cashflow and profit-split tool for business partners: track income, expenses, partner draws, tax reserve and monthly close together in real time. Available in English, Polish and Ukrainian.

## Pages

- [App](https://splitbooks.pl/): the SplitBooks application (sign-in required)
- [Help](https://splitbooks.pl/help): user guide and FAQ
- [Pricing](https://splitbooks.pl/pricing): plans and pricing
- [Privacy](https://splitbooks.pl/privacy): privacy policy
- [Terms](https://splitbooks.pl/terms): terms of service
